query: how does the kube-scheduler place pods onto nodes
notes: Five MANIFEST docs, one chunk each. Vector ranks and FTS ranks disagree so RRF order differs from either pool. Injected FlashRank scores disagree with RRF so rerank order is a third permutation.

chunks.text: A Pod is the smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes. The control plane schedules each Pod onto a node.
kube-scheduler assigns unscheduled Pods to nodes using filters and scoring plugins.
Azure Kubernetes Service runs the same kube-scheduler so pods land on AKS nodes.
A Service exposes a set of Pods. It does not schedule workloads onto nodes.
A Deployment manages ReplicaSets and rolling updates for stateless Pods.
